I wrote the solution in `main.wj`. It passes `wj check` with no errors or warnings. Example 1 (`the 3`, `and 1`) came out right in the interpreter. I didn't run Example 2 or any other inputs, and I didn't do a compiled build.

It reads K from the first line, counts lower-cased alphanumeric words from the rest, and prints the top K by count descending, then word ascending.
